localChanges: In Customise…, Civilization II can now be played on the square or hex map as well as its own isometric one, drawn with civ.one's pixel art, at Civilization's world sizes. New Game starts it on whichever map you last played it on (#1249).

log: The square and hexagonal descriptors now draw Civ2's Glacier with the arctic sprites, its variants and flavour pictures among them, and its River, a feature on any land, with the river sprites over that land, as the isometric pack already does.

Civilization II's world was refused on any grid but its own staggered isometric one. Its generator, rivers, specials and huts all follow the grid's own edges, so the square and hexagonal grids are allowed too, with the isometric grid still the default (civ-clone/web-renderer#1249). Its Earth stays on its own grid.
